reason: I am not going to be the guinea pig for a company with no restaurants live. Setup and staff training take time I don't have in a normal week, and my staff would still ring every order on the POS, so the kitchen screen is extra work before it saves me any.
objection: Who else is using this? Nobody is live yet, so I'd be paying R699 a month to find out what it does to my floor and my service.
would_change_my_mind: A working restaurant like mine that I can call and visit, showing fewer walk-outs or faster table turns, with the setup done on site and a free trial month before the first charge.
